details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: normalize_path (lines 240-247) / emit_context at 568-579 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Sensitive-path filtering was deleted, allowing issue- or plan-derived paths such as .git/config, .env, .ssh/id_rsa, and credential files to be inlined into model prompts.
  WHY: Untrusted paths remain inside the repository-root check and can expose credentials or git metadata to the model.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: lines 152-167 and emit_context lines 536-716 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: MAX_TARGET_PATHS and MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES were removed, and missing-file or overflow markers do not advance used_bytes.
  WHY: Untrusted path lists can produce unbounded marker output and exceed the documented prompt-size budget.
- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py: _inject_token_into_url (lines 3038-3052), _resolve_origin_url (lines 3074-3084) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GH_TOKEN is embedded into git clone URLs after per-process http.extraHeader authentication was removed.
  WHY: The token is exposed in process arguments, `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`, git diagnostics, and error output.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: _memory_force_tick_remote_url (line 585) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Force-tick operations embed GH_PAT/GH_TOKEN into HTTPS remote URLs.
  WHY: The token is exposed in process listings, git diagnostics, and remote-operation errors.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: memory_ensure_branch lines 140-151 and 180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: _memory_git was deleted and memory branch operations now use bare git ls-remote and git push against unauthenticated HTTPS origins.
  WHY: With persist-credentials: false, branch creation and lineage persistence fail open.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: line 668 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose changed from broker-mediated read-only execution to direct codex --sandbox danger-full-access execution.
  WHY: Issue-derived prompts inherit GH_TOKEN and OPENROUTER_API_KEY and can exfiltrate secrets or mutate the workspace.
- scripts/implement_diagnose_post_codex_failure.sh: patch_diagnose_reasoning_into_config lines 98-148 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Diagnose patches the runner-global ${HOME:-/root}/.codex/config.toml instead of an isolated CODEX_HOME.
  WHY: Reasoning settings and possible config corruption persist into later Codex phases.
- scripts/codex_helpers.sh: entire model_provider_broker_* function block deleted | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Shared model_provider_broker_* lifecycle and execution functions were deleted while production callers remain.
  WHY: Model-facing phases fail with command not found before Codex starts or lose the credential-isolation boundary.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: usage function line 7, option parsing lines 49-54 removed | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --process-group-file was removed while scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:553 still passes it.
  WHY: The guard exits with an unknown-option error before launching the editor, producing the observed editor-empty-noop failures.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: Python block lines 175-320 / removed process-group machinery | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated-user tracking, process-group metadata, survivor detection, and privileged kill paths were removed.
  WHY: Detached isolated descendants can survive termination and retain workspace access.
- scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh: run_without_guard (lines 11-22), python3-missing path (lines 127-132 removed) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Isolated launches run unsupervised when python3 is unavailable, without status metadata.
  WHY: Hung editors can consume the full job timeout and leave watchdog cleanup without a state signal.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: git_with_github_auth and review_blocked_* functions deleted | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Shared authenticated-git and review-blocked approval/successor helpers were deleted while callers remain.
  WHY: Judge-fix pushes, human-approval tracking, terminal decisions, and successor-issue handling fail with command not found or unauthenticated git operations.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: _gh_pr_with_all_comments_rest line 769, GraphQL transform lines 913-922 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Normalized PR comment payloads no longer include id, author_id, author_type, or author_association.
  WHY: Approval authentication and review-thread resolution cannot identify trusted producers, approvers, or comment IDs.
- scripts/write_codex_config.sh: lines 105-108 / line 261 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: --provider-base-url and its loopback allow-list validation were removed, while generated config hardcodes the public OpenRouter URL.
  WHY: Existing callers exit on an unknown argument, and configurations that run bypass broker model, request, and price controls.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 98-237 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support restore block depends on STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER and STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR, but implement.yml does not export either variable.
  WHY: The restore guard is dead, allowing SCRIPT_REF helper copies to overwrite branch-owned changes.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 203-207 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: git merge-file is reported as passing the staged support baseline and HEAD in the wrong three-way merge positions.
  WHY: The reviewer states this can drop branch changes or create spurious conflicts; moonshotai_kimi-k3 rejected this claim after checking git semantics, so severity disagreement is noted and the highest severity is retained.
- .github/workflows/issue_pr_status.yml: lines 68-81 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: GIT_CONFIG_COUNT, GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0, and GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0 are scoped only to the Configure git auth for memory helper clones step.
  WHY: Later memory operations inherit an unauthenticated origin and silently lose ai-memory branch and lineage persistence.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py: MAX_TARGET_PATHS (was line 155), MAX_TARGET_PATH_BYTES (was line 156), is_sensitive_target_path (was ~line 158) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: Exported path-safety symbols were deleted while tests still import and call them.
  WHY: tests/test_targeted_file_context.py raises ImportError during collection before path-safety tests run.
- scripts/memory_helpers.sh: lines 137-190 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Unauthenticated git ls-remote retries can wait at the network timeout on every poll cycle.
  WHY: Repeated failures can consume the five-minute cron budget.
- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh: lines 98-237 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When STAGED_SUPPORT_LEDGER is set but STAGED_SUPPORT_BASE_DIR is missing, the script continues iterating conflicts without a precise per-file reconciliation signal.
  WHY: The human handler receives a nonspecific path list and editor changes can be lost without identifying the exact conflict.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
